Step 2. Consider the projective operator \(W_{01320012}\) acting on the homogeneous space. By the projective decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01320012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320012\).

Step 3. The real functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the topological space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the real embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
